method: Ghidra decompilation and call-path inspection. No live-game visibility or rendering check was performed.

spawnFunction.finding: Spawns a distinct kind-6 child through func_802171A8(root, func_08002D18_703E18, 6) and writes the root pointer into child +0xD0.

initializer.finding: On its later scheduler invocation, sets child entity halfword +0x5E to 0x1B0 and child health byte +0x8D to 5. Task +0x04 is a mutable pointer-to-pointer backlink and does not identify the stable parent.

proximity.finding: Schedules func_08002F58_704058 when fabs(player_object.Z - child_object.Z) is less than 200.0. This uses Z separation, not full 3D distance.

entry.finding: At zero child HP, schedules func_080031D8_7042D8.

continuation.finding: Deletes the child at the end of the native death chain.

mindControlRobotChild.confidence: Ghidra-verified task creation, child identity, health initialization, proximity check and death chain; runtime visibility was not checked.

neutralState.finding: The entity-0xCC lives carrier has 12 remaining lives in byte +0xD1.

genericDamage.finding: The common actor path resets the carrier's generic health byte +0x8D to 10; this byte is separate from the +0xD1 lives count.

update.finding: The initialized health-bearing root has 12 HP in byte +0x8D; its custom lethal path proceeds at one remaining HP.

tsuramiHealthRoot.confidence: Ghidra-verified initialized root health and custom lethal threshold.

scope: These values describe the Congo mind-control robot child, Dharumanyo lives carrier, and Tsurami health root. They do not make Congo's boss-root HP interchangeable with any child or carrier field.
